% Files of the document in subfolders, named like index.4ht and
% glossary.4ht, that name themselves with \ProvidesFile and a date and a
% version: index.tex with its extension, glossary without one. They are
% read with makeidx and hyperref. As in the PDF, each file's text is in
% the page, and makeidx's index keeps its title and its entry.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{makeidx}
\makeindex
\usepackage{hyperref}
\input{test-provname/index}
\input{test-provname/option/glossary}
\begin{document}
\section{Files}
A ring\index{ring}.

Index: \provindex

Glossary: \provglossary
\printindex
\end{document}
